name: heavypad disk space critical
description: HeavyPad root/Postgres filesystem is critically low: below 5% or 30 GiB available, or below 2% free inodes.
query:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT start_timestamp,
    CAST(attributes->>'disk_free_bytes' AS BIGINT) AS free_bytes,
    CAST(attributes->>'disk_free_ratio' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS free_ratio,
    CAST(attributes->>'disk_free_inode_ratio' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS free_inode_ratio
  FROM records
  WHERE service_name = 'bandwidth-watchdog'
    AND attributes->>'watchdog_event' = 'disk.sample'
    AND attributes->>'host' = 'heavypad'
    AND start_timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'HeavyPad root/Postgres disk space CRITICAL' AS message, start_timestamp, free_bytes, free_ratio, free_inode_ratio FROM latest WHERE (free_ratio < 0.05 OR free_bytes < 32212254720 OR free_inode_ratio < 0.02)
